description: This file defines the AttachmentRepository class, which manages database operations related to attachments in an application. It includes methods for inserting, finding, deleting, and updating attachment records, as well as retrieving usage statistics and file names.

classes.name: AttachmentRepository
classes.description: A repository class responsible for CRUD operations and queries related to attachments in the database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new attachment record into the database using data from an Attachment object.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an Attachment object from the database by its ID.

methods.name: findByParentId
methods.description: Finds attachments associated with a specific parent type and ID, optionally filtered by MIME type.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes an attachment record by its ID.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns statistics on total number of attachments and cumulative file size.

methods.name: getFileNameById
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of an attachment by its ID.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates specific columns of an attachment record by its ID.
